messages:
phil: someone put fortune cookies in the kitchen with... weird model-themed fortunes. who deployed Fortune-Bot? :cookie:

phil: ```
1) "Your next PR will merge itself, but only after one polite apology." (Generated by Fortune-Bot v0.9 - trained on commit messages)
2) "A cache hit approaches; prepare the cookies." (Generated by Fortune-Bot v0.9 - trained on infra puns)
3) "The embedding of your heart is closer than you think." (Generated by Fortune-Bot v0.9 - trained on docs + rom-coms)
4) "You will find a missing semicolon and 20 cents under your keyboard." (Generated by Fortune-Bot v0.9 - trained on junior dev logs)
```

anya: omg the commit apology one is too accurate :joy:

ricardo: embedding of your heart... is that an eval metric now? :thinking_face:

sam: favorite: "prepare the cookies" is basically our SLOs in snack form

fortune-bot: automated: persona set to `wholesome-ops-poet`. Source: #kitchen-automation testing. Would you like to run a new fortune batch? [yes/no]

phil: @fortune-bot yes but please add one that's purely a dad-joke about transformers

anya: contest idea: potluck fortune remix. rewrite a fortune in the voice of a model family (e.g., 'Transformer dad', 'RNN grandma', 'Diffusion hipster') winner gets a bag of cookies and a $10 lunch card. cc @culture

ricardo: challenge accepted. I'm doing 'RNN grandma' like it remembers everything but repeats the punchline three times

sam: poll: which persona for the next batch?
sam: 1) Transformer dad
sam: 2) RNN grandma
sam: 3) Diffusion hipster
sam: 4) SRE oracle

anya: vote: SRE oracle for maximum uptime metaphors

fortune-bot: note: privacy toggle enabled -> fortunes will not include identifying info or timestamps.

phil: tiny ops request: can fortunes include a suffix like "(generated for office fun only)" so they don't freak out visitors

fortune-bot: preference saved: suffix added. Example: "Your next PR will merge itself... (generated for office fun only)"

culture: loving this lol. putting $15 in the snack fund for the potluck fortune remix contest. Tag entries with #fortune-potluck by Friday 3pm :tada:

ricardo: will submit 'RNN grandma' entry tonight. It will lovingly repeat the same advice three times 

anya: also hub idea: store winning fortunes in a repo called `office-fortunes` so we can seed future bots

sam: adding beret to Diffusion hipster persona because aesthetics 

phil: closing thread with rules: 1) keep it PG, 2) no personal data, 3) winner gets cookies, 4) bots get berets if overly dramatic :beret:

culture: posted. good luck chefs and prompt engineers :chef:
